# `match var v = subject` on every target: a subject that calls is called
# once, an option narrows to its element past the null arm, the name is a
# writable local in a block run imperatively, and is read in place in a view.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '4 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
// `match var v = subject` names the subject for the arms, as `for var x = xs`
// names the element. In an arm whose one pattern is a member carrying a
// payload the name is that payload (enum_payload.sngl); in every other arm it
// is the subject, and the subject's element where the subject is an option
// the arm is not taken on null.

import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

enum Status { active, inactive, pending }

func name(s Status) => match s {
    active => "on"
    inactive => "off"
    pending => "waiting"
}

var rolls = 0

func roll() int {
    rolls = rolls + 1
    return rolls * 7
}

// A subject that calls something is called once, and the name reads that.
func describe() => match var n = roll() {
    7 => "seven"
    else => "rolled {n}"
}

// Past the null arm the name is the element, which name() takes.
func show(s option[Status]) => match var v = s {
    null => "none"
    else => name(v)
}

// An arm whose patterns cannot be null narrows as well.
func onOrNot(s option[Status]) => match var v = s {
    active => name(v)
    else => "not on"
}

// In a block run imperatively the name is a local the arm may write.
func clamp(n int) int {
    match var v = n {
        0 { return 1 }
        else {
            if v > 10 {
                v = 10
            }
            return v
        }
    }
}

component panel node {
    var maybe option[Status] = null

    text #shown(value=match var v = maybe {
        null => "none"
        else => name(v)
    })
    match var v = maybe {
        null {}
        else { text #named(value=name(v)) }
    }

    button #set(text="Set", @click { maybe = Status.pending })
}

func testOnce(t Test, c panel) {
    t.assert(describe() == "seven")
    t.assert(describe() == "rolled 14")
    t.assert(rolls == 2)
}

func testNarrow(t Test, c panel) {
    t.assert(show(null) == "none")
    t.assert(show(Status.inactive) == "off")
    t.assert(onOrNot(Status.active) == "on")
    t.assert(onOrNot(null) == "not on")
}

func testLocal(t Test, c panel) {
    t.assert(clamp(0) == 1)
    t.assert(clamp(4) == 4)
    t.assert(clamp(40) == 10)
}

func testView(t Test, c panel) {
    t.assert(c.shown.value == "none")
    t.assert(c.named == null)
    c.set.click()
    t.assert(c.shown.value == "waiting")
    t.assert(c.named != null)
}
